more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Polyvinylpyrrolidone is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include table-top sweeteners in tablets, food supplements supplied in a solid form excluding food supplements for infants and  young children’,. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
